content: Despite its extensive application on text classification BIBREF13 , BIBREF14 , BIBREF15 , this method was initially proposed for document indexing and, therefore, does not encode any class information when modeling the low-rank approximation. To perform classification, 1-nearest neighbor is usually performed, placing a query document into the class of the nearest training document.
